note: Blinis with crème fraîche and salmon, garlic toast with tomato and basil

steps.text: Top the blinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon.
Slice and toast the baguette, then rub with garlic.
Dice the tomatoes, mix with torn basil and pile on the toasts.

note: Buttermilk brined fried drumsticks, best served before midnight

dish.make_ahead: Brine the day before, fry on the day

steps.text: Brine the drumsticks overnight in the buttermilk and hot sauce.
Mix the flour with the paprika, garlic powder and white pepper. Dredge the chicken twice.
Fry at 165C in batches until 75C at the bone.
Serve well before midnight.

note: Charred kielbasa with slow cooked onions and wholegrain mustard on toothpicks

steps.text: Slice the kielbasa thick on the diagonal and slice the onions.
Griddle the sausage until charred.
Cook the onions slowly in the butter until soft.
Toss together with the mustard and spear on toothpicks.
Chop the chocolate.
Heat the milk until steaming, then whisk in the chocolate until frothy.
Pour into four mugs and pile marshmallows on top.

note: Small baked beef and onion meatballs, meatloaf in bite form

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk. Grate the onion.
Mix lightly with the mince, egg and salt, then roll into 20 balls.
Bake at 200C until cooked through.
Mix the tomato sauce with the brown sugar, brush over and bake a few minutes more.

note: Breadsticks wound in fishnet style prosciutto, whipped ricotta to dip

steps.text: Cut the prosciutto into long thin strips and wind criss-cross around the breadsticks like fishnet.
Stand them up in a tall glass.
Whip the ricotta with salt and pepper and serve in a small bowl alongside.

note: Piped egg halves, smoked salmon on rye squares, brown sugar glazed cocktail franks

steps.text: Boil the eggs hard, cool, peel and halve.
Whip the yolks with mayonnaise and pipe back into the whites.
Top buttered rye squares with smoked salmon.
Glaze the franks in a pan with the sugar and a splash of water.
Serve on silver trays.

note: Blue jelly with gummy fish, whipped cream, shortbread sand, white chocolate shell

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, add toppings just before serving

steps.text: Make the jelly as the packet says and pour half into four glasses.
Chill until just setting, push in gummy fish, add the rest and set.
Whip the cream and crush the shortbread.
Top with cream, shortbread for sand and a white chocolate shell.

note: Rosewater panna cotta topped with crushed raspberries and a sugared rose petal

steps.text: Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water.
Warm the cream with most of the sugar, stir in the squeezed gelatine and the rosewater, and pour into four glasses.
Set in the fridge.
Crush the raspberries with the remaining sugar and spoon on top with a rose petal.
Mix the apple juice with the lemon juice and pour into a tray to freeze.
Freeze, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes.
Whip the cream and fold in the marshmallow creme.
Spoon the slush into glasses and top with the cream. Brew a pot of English breakfast tea for the grown-ups.

note: Smashed baby potatoes with cheddar, bacon, sour cream and chives

dish.n: Mr Potato Head loaded potato bites

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender and drain.
Smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220C until crisp.
Grate the cheddar, crisp and chop the bacon.
Top with cheese and bacon and return to the oven.
Add sour cream and chopped chives.

note: Salmon, avocado and cucumber rolled in nori, with soy and pickled ginger

steps.text: Rinse and cook the rice, then season with the vinegar and sugar and cool.
Slice the salmon, avocado and cucumber into strips.
Spread rice over the nori, lay the fillings along each and roll tight.
Slice with a wet knife and serve with soy and pickled ginger.

note: the soup Linguini ruins and Remy fixes

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled, reheat gently

steps.text: Sweat the leeks in the butter over low heat until soft.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer until the potato is very tender.
Blend silky smooth with the cream and season.
Serve topped with chives and white pepper. Anyone can cook.

note: anyone can cook, even a perfect baguette lunch

steps.text: Take the salted butter out of the fridge so it is soft at room temperature.
Warm the baguettes in a 200C oven for 6 minutes until the crust crackles when you squeeze it.
Split each baguette lengthways and spread thickly with the butter.
Fill with folds of the ham and slices of brie, close and cut into short lengths to share.

note: Prawns tossed in garlic and chilli butter with stock and lemon

steps.text: Peel the prawns and slice the garlic.
Melt the butter until foaming, add the garlic and chilli and cook briefly.
Add the prawns and toss over high heat until just pink.
Add the stock and lemon juice and bubble briefly. Finish with chopped parsley and serve with crusty bread.

note: Lobster salad with mayo, celery and chives in a buttered toasted bun

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 3 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Chop the lobster and fold with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, finely diced celery and chives.
Butter the split buns and toast in a pan.
Pile the filling in.

note: Sliced pink lamb backstrap, mint mayo, lettuce and tomato on toasted sourdough

steps.text: Sear the lamb to pink in a hot pan.
Rest, then slice thin.
Toast the sourdough. Mix the mayonnaise with chopped mint.
Build with crisp cos, ripe tomato and the lamb. When the mutton is nice and lean.

note: Flaky pastry filled with spiced beef, thyme and scotch bonnet

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, or freeze

steps.text: Chop the onion and chilli finely.
Fry the mince with the onion, thyme, chilli, allspice and curry powder, then cool.
Cut the pastry into rounds and brush with turmeric water. Fill, fold and crimp.
Bake at 200C.

note: Toasted marshmallows and milk chocolate squashed between crisp cookies

steps.text: Toast the marshmallows over a flame until blistered and molten.
Squash each between two biscuits with a square of chocolate so it melts. Eat them by the handful.

note: Chopped clams folded into cream cheese and sour cream, with potato chips

steps.text: Drain the clams, keeping a little juice.
Fold the clams into the cream cheese and sour cream with lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and chopped chives.
Serve with potato chips.

note: Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, glazed with soy, brown sugar and ginger

steps.text: Drain the water chestnuts and wrap each in half a rasher of bacon.
Brush with the soy, sugar and ginger.
Bake at 200C until sticky.

note: Buttermilk soaked calamari in a cornmeal crust, with tartare and lemon

steps.text: Cut the calamari into strips and soak in the buttermilk.
Soak.
Dredge in cornmeal mixed with flour.
Fry at 185C in batches.
Serve with tartare and lemon wedges.

note: Hot smoked trout, cream cheese, dill and horseradish dip with crackers

steps.text: Flake the trout.
Mix into the cream cheese and sour cream with lemon juice, chopped dill and horseradish.
Spoon into a small bucket and serve with crackers.
Mix the chilli flakes with the salt on a plate.
Rub the rims of four pint glasses with lime and dip in the salt. Fill with ice.
Add lime juice, hot sauce, Worcestershire sauce and tomato juice to each glass.
Top each with cold lager, stir once and crush the can.

note: Crisp fried ham croquettes with a creamy center, lime to squeeze over

dish.make_ahead: Roll up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until very thick.
Stir in the chopped ham and chill overnight.
Shape into logs, roll in beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C in batches.
Serve with lime.

note: Triple decker turkey and bacon sandwiches with lettuce, tomato and mayo

steps.text: Grill the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread.
Layer turkey, bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise across three slices each.
Pin with toothpicks and cut into quarters.

note: Baked crisp chicken wings tossed in honey barbecue sauce

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Toss with garlic powder and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the barbecue sauce with the honey and toss the wings through.

note: Cheddar and cream cheese balls rolled in toasted pecans

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese with grated cheddar, Worcestershire sauce and chopped spring onions.
Roll into golf ball sizes and chill.
Toast and crush the pecans, roll the balls in them and spear each with a toothpick.

note: Baked potato skins filled with cheddar and bacon, sour cream on top

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Halve, scoop out and brush with melted butter.
Crisp the skins at 220C.
Fill with cheddar and bacon and bake again.
Top with sour cream and chives.

note: Skewered prawns brushed with smoked paprika garlic butter, lemon to squeeze

steps.text: Peel the prawns and thread onto skewers.
Melt the butter with crushed garlic, paprika and cayenne and brush over.
Grill, turning once, and squeeze lemon over.

note: Baked in garlic, shallot and brandy butter until sizzling, snails or mushroom caps

steps.text: Mash the butter with crushed garlic, chopped parsley, finely chopped shallot and a splash of brandy.
Put the escargot in a baking dish and cover each one with the butter.
Bake at 200C until sizzling. Serve with baguette.

note: Charred broccolini with garlic and oyster sauce, stood up like little trees

steps.text: Blanch the broccolini and drain. Slice the garlic.
Char in a smoking pan with the garlic.
Toss with oyster sauce and sesame oil. Stand them up in a dish like trees.

note: Soft pleated buns filled with char siu pork in oyster and hoisin sauce

dish.make_ahead: Fill and steam on the day

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and warm water into a dough and knead.
Prove the dough.
Chop the pork and mix with the oyster sauce, hoisin and sugar.
Divide the dough into 12 rounds, fill and pleat shut.
Prove again.
Steam.

note: Salmon and tuna nigiri with wasabi, served with pickled ginger

steps.text: Cook the sushi rice, season with the vinegar, sugar and salt and cool.
Shape the rice into small fingers.
Slice the salmon and tuna, top the rice with a dab of wasabi and a slice of fish.
Serve on a board with pickled ginger.

note: Warm cheddar and jalapeño dip with corn chips and beef jerky

dish.n: Jalapeño cheese dip with chips, jerky

steps.text: Grate the cheddar and chop the jalapeños.
Warm the evaporated milk until steaming, then stir in the cheddar until smooth.
Add the jalapeño juice and jalapeños.
Pour into plastic bowls with corn chips and jerky on the side.

note: Soy and ginger marinated chicken, double fried until crisp, with mayo and lemon

steps.text: Cut the chicken into pieces and mix with the soy, sake, ginger and crushed garlic.
Marinate in the fridge.
Coat in potato starch and fry at 160C, then rest.
Fry again at 190C until crisp.
Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.

note: Shaved rib eye and melted provolone in mini rolls

steps.text: Freeze the steak for 30 minutes so it firms up, then shave as thin as you can.
Sear the onion on a hot plate in oil until soft, then push aside and sear the beef quickly.
Lay the provolone over the meat to melt.
Split the rolls and pile the filling in.

note: Salami, prosciutto, provolone, artichokes, olives and roasted peppers, crusty bread

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, cover and keep chilled

steps.text: Drain the artichokes, olives and capsicum.
Arrange the meats and sliced provolone on a board with the jar items.
Serve with the loaf torn into pieces.

note: Buckwheat pancakes with sour cream, smoked salmon and dill

dish.make_ahead: Batter can rest up to 2 hours

steps.text: Mix both flours, yeast and warm milk into a batter and rest until bubbly.
Cook small spoonfuls in butter in a pan until golden on both sides.
Top each with sour cream, a curl of smoked salmon and dill.

film: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004)
note: the pride of San Diego, Ron's town

steps.text: Mix the steak with the lime juice, garlic and cumin.
Marinate for 1 hour (included in cook time).
Grill the steak hot, 3 minutes a side, then rest and chop.
Bake the fries on a tray at 220C until crisp.
Cover with Monterey Jack and grill to melt.
Top with the steak, avocado and sour cream.

note: Prawn on cucumber, honey ricotta toasts, figs wrapped in prosciutto

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the cucumber into rounds and top with prawns bound in lemon mayonnaise.
Toast baguette slices and top with ricotta whipped with honey.
Halve the figs and wrap each half in prosciutto.
Serve on silver trays.

film: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby (2006)
note: Franks dipped in buttermilk cornmeal batter and fried deep golden, with mustard

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a thick batter.
Pat the franks dry and push onto sticks.
Heat the oil to 180C. Dip each frank in batter and fry until deep golden.
Serve with mustard.

film: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby (2006)
note: Thin crêpes, some folded around ham and gruyère, some with sugar and lemon

dish.n: Jean Girard's ham and cheese crêpes

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk to a smooth batter and rest.
Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan.
Fold half around the ham and gruyere and warm until melted.
Sprinkle the rest with sugar and lemon juice.

note: Cucumber, celery, carrot and radish sticks with a blue cheese sour cream dip

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the cucumber, celery, carrots and radishes into long lean sticks.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream with lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce and black pepper.
Stand the sticks in a glass on ice and serve with the dip.

note: Cucumber rounds with whipped goat cheese, smoked salmon and dill

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep very cold

steps.text: Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds.
Whip the goat's cheese with lemon zest and pipe on top.
Add a curl of smoked salmon and a dill frond.
Chill until serving.

note: Tuna and celery salad with lemon mayo on cucumber rounds, dill and pepper

steps.text: Drain the tuna and mix with the mayonnaise, finely diced celery, spring onion and lemon juice.
Cut the cucumbers into thick rounds.
Spoon on the tuna and finish with dill and black pepper. Keep it away from the cat.

note: Pan fried crab cakes with celery salt and paprika, served with lemon

steps.text: Fold the crab with the mayonnaise, egg, Dijon, celery salt, paprika and breadcrumbs.
Shape into 8 cakes.
Chill.
Pan-fry in the butter until golden.
Serve with lemon.

note: Prawn salad with celery and chives in a buttered toasted hot dog bun

steps.text: Chop the prawns and fold with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, diced celery and chives.
Butter the cut sides of the buns and toast.
Pile the prawns in.

note: Crisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce butter and honey, blue cheese dip

steps.text: Dry the wings uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the wings.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream to dip.
Serve with celery sticks.

note: Jalapeños stuffed with cream cheese and cheddar, wrapped in bacon and baked

steps.text: Halve and seed the jalapenos.
Mix the cream cheese with the grated cheddar and fill each half.
Wrap in half a rasher of bacon each.
Bake at 200C until the bacon is crisp.

note: Poached prawns on ice with tomato horseradish cocktail sauce

steps.text: Poach the prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel, leaving the tails on.
Mix the tomato sauce with horseradish and lemon juice.
Chill the prawns.
Pile the prawns on a bag of crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges.

note: Mature cheddar, pork pie, pickled onions, chutney, apple and crusty bread

steps.text: Take the cheddar out of the fridge an hour ahead so it comes up to room temperature.
Cut the cheddar into thick slices and the pork pie into wedges.
Arrange on a board with pickled onions, chutney, sliced apple and bread, with a dish of butter.

note: Soft boiled eggs wrapped in sausage, crumbed and fried, with English mustard

dish.n: Village of the Year fete scotch eggs
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, serve cold or reheat at 180C

steps.text: Boil four of the eggs for 6 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Wrap each egg in seasoned sausage mince, pressing it smooth and even.
Roll in flour, the remaining beaten egg, then panko.
Fry at 170C until deep golden and cooked through, then halve.
Serve with English mustard.

note: Baguette bites with pork pâté, char siu, pickled carrot, cucumber and cilantro

dish.n: Four Leaf's jungle banh mi bites

steps.text: Cut the carrot and daikon into matchsticks and quick-pickle in the vinegar and sugar.
Split the baguettes and spread with pate.
Fill with char siu, drained pickles, cucumber, coriander and chilli.
Cut into bites.

note: Beef and pork meatballs simmered in tomato sauce, served on toothpicks

dish.make_ahead: Make ahead up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Mix the minces with parmesan, chopped parsley, garlic and some salt. Roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in batches in a pan.
Simmer in the crushed tomatoes until cooked through.
Serve on toothpicks.

note: Small ham, cheese and pickle and egg and lettuce sandwiches, each labeled with a name

dish.n: Ned's labeled ham and egg sandwiches

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise.
Make ham, cheese and pickle sandwiches, and egg and lettuce sandwiches.
Cut small, wrap each in baking paper and write a name on it in marker.
Chill until needed.

note: Roast chicken, rocket and feta rolled with pink beetroot chickpea spread

dish.make_ahead: Roast the beetroot a day ahead

steps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast at 200C until tender, then peel.
Blitz with the drained chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and garlic until pink and smooth.
Spread on the tortillas and fill with chicken, rocket and crumbled feta.
Roll tight and slice into spirals.

note: Thick tray pizza with pepperoni and mozzarella, cut into squares

dish.make_ahead: Reheat in the oven, up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Press the dough into an oiled tray right to the edges.
Spread with crushed tomatoes mixed with oregano and top with mozzarella and pepperoni.
Bake at 240C until bubbling and golden.
Cut into squares.
Heat the milk until steaming.
Whisk in the chopped chocolate, cocoa, sugar and cinnamon until smooth.
Pour into a warmed thermos to keep hot, then serve in mugs topped with marshmallows.

film: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs (2009)
note: Mashed sardines with lemon and parsley on sourdough toast, sliced radish

steps.text: Toast the sourdough.
Mash the drained sardines with the butter, lemon juice and chopped parsley.
Spread on the toast and top with thinly sliced radish and black pepper.

film: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs (2009)
note: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and onion on slider buns

steps.text: Roll the mince into 12 small balls.
Smash on a hot griddle and cook briefly, then melt a slice of cheese on each.
Mix the mayonnaise into a burger sauce and slice the pickles and onion.
Fill the buns and stack them high on a platter.

note: Thinly sliced raw scallops with lime, finger lime pearls, olive oil and sea salt

steps.text: Chill the plates.
Slice the scallops very thin and lay on the plates.
Dress with lime juice, finger lime pearls, a few drops of oil and sea salt.

note: Smooth potato soup with kale and smoked sausage, olive oil on top

steps.text: Simmer the potatoes and onion in the stock until soft, then mash smooth.
Shred the kale finely and slice the sausage.
Add both and simmer.
Drizzle with olive oil.

note: Mini quiche tarts with brie, ham and chives

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Cut rounds from the pastry, line a 24 hole mini muffin tin and blind-bake.
Dice the brie and ham and chop the chives.
Fill the cases. Whisk the eggs with the cream, pour in and bake at 170C.
Bake until just set.

note: Buttermilk biscuits under creamy sausage gravy

steps.text: Rub the butter into part of the flour with the baking powder and stir in the buttermilk.
Cut rounds and bake at 220C.
Brown the sausage mince, stir in the remaining flour and then the milk.
Simmer with lots of pepper until thick.
Split the biscuits and pour over the gravy.

note: the café's famous dish

dish.make_ahead: Remoulade up to 2 days ahead, fry just before serving

steps.text: Slice the tomatoes thick, salt them and leave for 10 minutes (included in cook time).
Mix the mayonnaise with chopped capers and lemon juice for the remoulade.
Cook the bacon in a large pan until crisp and the fat has run, and set the bacon aside.
Dip the tomatoes in buttermilk then seasoned cornmeal and fry in the bacon fat until golden, turning once.

note: Kale or collards braised for hours with smoked ham hock and garlic

dish.n: Big Mama's ham hock braised greens

steps.text: Simmer the hock in water with the sliced onion, garlic and chilli flakes.
Strip the stems from the kale and chop. Add and braise gently.
Pick the meat off the hock and stir it back in.
Finish with the vinegar and serve in bowls with plenty of pot liquor.

note: Pecorino shards with chili honey, prosciutto wrapped rockmelon and mint

steps.text: Cut the pecorino into shards. Warm the honey with chilli flakes and drizzle over.
Wrap prosciutto around wedges of rockmelon and add mint leaves.
Chop the parsley with capers, lemon zest and oil for salsa verde.
Toast baguette slices, spread with salsa verde and top each with an anchovy.
Lay it all out in neat rows on a long board.

note: Fried tomato risotto balls with a melted mozzarella center

steps.text: Cook the rice with the tomatoes and stock into a thick risotto.
Stir in the parmesan and cool completely.
Roll around cubes of mozzarella.
Crumb in beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180C until golden.

note: Hand shaped sushi rice topped with salmon or tuna, with pickled ginger and soy

steps.text: Rinse the rice and cook it.
Season with rice vinegar, sugar and salt and cool.
Shape into fingers with a touch of wasabi under each.
Slice the fish and lay on top. Serve with pickled ginger and soy.

note: Sliced grilled bratwurst in curry tomato sauce, dusted with curry powder

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and fry until golden.
Grill the bratwurst slowly until browned, then slice.
Soften the onion, add the tomato paste, curry powder, sugar, vinegar and water and simmer.
Pour over the sausage and dust with curry powder. Serve with the chips.

note: Ham and gruyère sandwiches with Dijon, topped with béchamel and cheese

dish.n: Particular set of skills croque monsieur
dish.make_ahead: Assemble ahead, bake just before serving

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and cook until thick.
Spread the bread with Dijon and bechamel.
Fill with ham and half the gruyere, then close.
Top with the rest of the sauce and cheese.
Bake at 200C until bubbling.

note: Fresh shucked oysters on ice with lemon and shallot mignonette

steps.text: Finely dice the shallots and mix with the vinegar and pepper.
Rest.
Lay the oysters on crushed ice with lemon wedges and the mignonette alongside.
